AI often struggles with wading birds, creating 'melting' legs or unrealistic reflections. Also, scrutinize the bill tip—is it truly spatulate (spoon-shaped) or just a generic pointed beak that has been warped? Verify if the lack of yellow on the bill is a species trait (e.g., Eurasian Spoonbill non-breeding) or a generation error, noting the visible yellow patch at the base.
